items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: With Bostic? A month after I’d joined him.

ctx.x: These were dances, yeah. No concerts. And we finally went to California in 1950, and that was Bostic’s first time there. And then went up to San Francisco and then up through [inaudible] and you’d come back the northern route where you would do Salt Lake City, Denver, Chicago and come through Ohio, and sometimes it’d be a three month tour.
